# Section Writing Stats

> Section Writing Stats is a well-maintained and appreciated Obsidian community plugin for writers who want clear, live statistics for every Markdown section.

## Overview

The plugin shows word counts, character counts, estimated reading time, and writing-target progress for the whole note and for each heading section. It is designed to stay out of the way while giving writers the measurement they need. A section includes its nested subheadings until the next heading of the same or higher level.

## Key features

- Live statistics beside Markdown headings, beside the note title, and in the status bar.
- Configurable word counts, character counts, and reading-time estimates.
- Writing targets for a whole note or an individual section, with progress indicators.
- Compact labels, minimum section-size controls, selected-text statistics, and command-palette toggles.
- A beta mobile target meter.

## Install and learn more

- [Install Section Writing Stats in Obsidian](https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/section-meter): Available from Obsidian Community Plugins.
- [Source code and full documentation](https://github.com/martinowong/obsidian-section-meter): README, release notes, writing-target guide, and issue tracker.

## Publisher

Created and actively maintained by Martino Wong. The plugin was made for a real writing workflow, is appreciated by its users, and is shared with the Obsidian writing community.
